description: This is a Swift source file for a complex iOS application component named NodeAppModel. It manages app state, handles various system and custom commands, and communicates with backend services via web sockets and REST requests. The file includes classes and functions for device capabilities, notifications, camera, location, and app lifecycle management, as well as extensive integration with external services and modules.

classes.name: NotificationCallError
classes.description: Private struct encapsulating errors during notification calls, ensuring Sendable conformance.

classes.name: GatewayRelayIdentityResponse
classes.description: Decodable struct for handling gateway relay identity responses.

classes.name: NotificationInvokeLatch
classes.description: A final class to wrap asynchronous notification call responses, ensuring system prompt returns promptly.

classes.name: IOSDeepLinkAgentPolicy
classes.description: Enum-like structure holding constants for deep link message length limits.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Main final class managing app logic, state, system interactions, and backend communications for the iOS app.
